claim: Stress and spicy food cause stomach ulcers.

heard.who: Clinicians before 1982, as described by News-Medical (Susan Chow, PhD)
heard.quote: Clinicians thought that these lifestyle factors resulted in an overproduction of gastric acid, leading to the formation of ulcers.

answer: Mostly no. Until the 1980s doctors attributed ulcers to stress, lifestyle and excess stomach acid, but in 1982 Marshall and Warren cultured a bacterium, Helicobacter pylori, from stomach biopsies. Ulcers it causes can now be treated with antibiotics.

facts.text: In 1982 Barry Marshall and Robin Warren cultured a previously unknown bacterium, later named Helicobacter pylori, from the stomach biopsies of patients.
